Designed with advanced architecture that creates a one-of-a-kind experience, 713 Music Hall features an innovative setting with a sense of intimacy between the stage and guests. Its cutting-edge angled design provides guests with a viewing experience like none other and virtually no gaps in sight from the stage - only people.
